notes:
Short-form account notes + technical/ops details:
- Company profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics toolbox). Multi-tenant product, heavy embeddings-backed search + contextual chat for product discovery.
- Trial summary (Hosted API): running ~14 days, ingestion of 30k tokens/day avg, peak day 95k tokens. Observed baseline QPS: 3-6 sustained, peak QPS bursts up to 12 for short windows. Average tokens/req ~450 (mix of short UI prompts ~120 tokens and deep summarization ~1.2k tokens). Streaming used ~40% of requests (real-time UI).
- POC findings we captured: p95 latency on hosted -> 220–320ms for small prompts; long-run completions push >800ms. Electro-ops: concurrency observed during peak ~12 concurrent requests per node; they expect concurrency to rise as product scales.
- Desired Dedicated sizing targets (customer asks): sustained QPS target 15 (peak 45), p95 latency <250ms for typical UI flows, support for long-context sessions up to 8k tokens, ability to handle 3x growth within 6 months. They want reserved baseline capacity + 2-tier burst policy.
- Token mix and forecasting notes: current mix ~60% short (<256 tokens), 30% mid (256-1024), 10% long (>1024). Forecast: projected product launch -> 3x token volume in 6 months, peak concurrency x3. They want model of costs for 1x / 3x / 5x scenarios and GPU equivalence guidance (what dedicated pool size maps to expected QPS/concurrency).
- Architecture preferences & constraints: prefer VPC peering for Dedicated, KMS integration for key management, SSO (SAML) mandatory, audit logs retention 1 year, EU data residency for subset of customers.
- Commercial: price-sensitive vs performance — willing to commit to reserved capacity if we can guarantee cost per token and burst capacity behavior. Looking for clear comparison hosted vs dedicated TCO and uplift for 99.9% SLA.
- Quote ask: two flavors — (A) small dedicated pool to meet baseline QPS 15 with 3x headroom; (B) larger reserved for predictable throughput and lower per-token cost. Also want options for autoscale/burst credits.
- Risks / objections: procurement timeline (budget closes end of Q1), still evaluating OpenAI + Vertex + potential in-house inference build, SOC2 evidence required before procurement, need legal review for data residency clauses.
- Direct quote from product lead: "If latency spikes we lose flow — need consistent 200–300ms for key flows. Pricing needs to make sense at 3x scale or we'll stay hosted."
- Stubs/links: shared POC CSV with token-by-request breakdown (drive link above), Fireflies meeting ff-4f3a9b2e has full transcript.
- Immediate ask from AE: SE to produce dedicated-capacity spreadsheet mapping QPS/concurrency/token-mix -> GPU pool size (N GPUs of X spec) + estimated monthly cost windows (1x, 3x, 5x). Also send dedicated pricing template and SLA language to procurement.
